description: Business record memory: contracts, targets, vendor facts, onboarding.

items.content: The Acme Corporation contract renews on 2026-09-30 and includes a 5% annual uplift clause in section 4.2.
The platform team's Q1 revenue target was set to 1.2M USD in the original annual plan.
Correction (2026-02): after the enterprise pipeline review, the platform team's Q1 revenue target was revised to 1.35M USD.
The payment gateway vendor is Novapay; settlement is T+2 with a 1.9% blended fee.
Correction (2026-04): the payment gateway was migrated from Novapay to AuricPay; settlement is now T+1 with a 1.7% blended fee.
Client onboarding step 1: countersign the MSA and log the signed copy in the vault before any work starts.
Client onboarding step 2: after the MSA is logged, provision the client tenant with the starter template.
Client onboarding step 3: once the tenant is live, schedule the kickoff workshop within five business days.
The support SLA for enterprise accounts is a 4-business-hour first response.
The invoicing run executes on the last business day of each month at 18:00 UTC.
Office lease negotiations started in June; nothing is signed yet.

queries.query: when does the Acme contract renew and what uplift applies?
what is the platform team's current Q1 revenue target?
